column1: # BIMcollab's example project (KUBUS BV), public downloads linked from BIMcollab's help center
# ("Example projects and templates", helpcenter.bimcollab.com/en/articles/325099). Its structural model,
# 02_BIMcollab_Example_STR.rvt, is a Revit Architecture 2015 project (BasicFileInfo build 20141119_0715),
# and 02_BIMcollab_Example_STR_optimized.ifc is Revit 2015's own IFC2X3 Coordination View 2.0 export
# of it (IfcApplication "Autodesk Revit Architecture 2015 (ENU)", version 2015, 2014-10-08), later passed
# through Solibri's IFC Optimizer. No redistribution licence is stated, so both are fetched for a Measure
# run (`-f bimcollab=true`) by tools/ci/fetch-bimcollab.sh, never committed, and only the run's summary
# counts are uploaded (tools/ci/scrub-holdout-results.sh, Griffin, 2026-10-26). STE1200 gave the .rvt's
# provenance and sha256 (Discussion #112); the rest was measured 2026-10-21. The archives are checked
# through their members only: BIMcollab repacks them (bc-example-project_2025.zip).
